Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.debug

Class VisualDebugRenderer

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.debug.VisualDebugRenderer
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(name="brobot.debug.image.visual.enabled", havingValue="true") public class VisualDebugRenderer extends Object
Creates visual debugging output with annotated screenshots. Highlights search regions, matches, and provides visual comparison grids.
